observations.body: After Joshua’s death the carried bones reach land Jacob purchased, becoming an inheritance for Joseph’s children.
observations.label: Joseph’s bones are buried at Shechem

observations.body: The passage presents Joseph’s bones are buried as the scene's observable response or movement.

payload.posture: Read Joshua 24:29–33 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states after Joshua’s death the carried bones reach land Jacob purchased, becoming an inheritance for Joseph’s children. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
